tasks.short: Consider medical procedures in assessment, team communication and referrals.

steps.what: Retrieve actual patient records and relevant Western medical procedure information from checked sources
inputs: actual patient identity and permitted medical records
actual clinical procedure/reference sources and dates

steps.what: Consider actual Western medical procedures in health assessment and referral decisions
inputs: checked actual medical assessment context
actual patient account, examination and care needs
outputs: actual assessment and chosen care-team/referral needs

steps.what: Communicate actual assessment questions and care needs with the health care team
inputs: actual assessment and chosen care-team/referral needs
actual team responses and patient disclosure permissions
outputs: actual care-team discussion and referral arrangements

steps.what: Prepare actual referral and assessment record using native clinical record fields {OTHER}
inputs: actual assessment and chosen care-team/referral needs
actual care-team discussion and referral arrangements
checked actual medical assessment context
outputs: complete actual referral and assessment record draft

steps.what: Check final referral content, actual clinical meaning and exact permitted care recipient
inputs: complete actual referral and assessment record draft
actual patient disclosure permissions and referral destination
outputs: checked final actual assessment/referral content and permitted destinations

steps.what: Save the checked actual clinical assessment and referral record
inputs: checked final actual assessment/referral content and permitted destinations
outputs: saved actual assessment and referral record

steps.what: Send exact checked referral to the actual authorised health care recipient
inputs: checked final actual assessment/referral content and permitted destinations

tasks.design: Configure native medical-source links and patient/referral fields in clinical record and referral software {OTHER}, with references in {DOCS}. The acupuncturist retains actual health assessment and team communication, captures actual referral content and fully checks it before separate record save and referral send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Assessment/referral work can repeat source navigation and stable patient fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links and referral fields can reduce navigation and duplicate identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Appropriate assessment and referral depend on actual patient needs and professional scope.
tasks.human_edge: The practitioner recognises a concern requiring qualified medical assessment rather than a templated explanation.
tasks.altitude: Less referral administration; clinical judgement stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native clinical-source links and referral fields can support preparation; they do not determine an appropriate medical procedure or confer clinical authority.

assumptions: Actual clinical/reference owners supply records and procedure sources; practitioner checks identity/currentness in s1. Actual assessment, patient discussion and team/referral decisions stay retained in s2/s3.
S4 cuts repeated identifiers/headings only; actual new clinical meaning and team arrangement capture stay in retained 11.2 hours. Complete final clinical/disclosure check remains in s5.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Assessment, team communication and referral are alternative actual branches; remove unused referral/record/send work and reweight. Native fields first; existing automated fields earn zero saving.

Save/send each retain one percent using existing final check after complete referral exists. Actual patient disclosure permission and appropriate clinical scope must hold; no automatic referral, diagnosis or new authority is assumed.
research_questions: Can native fields reduce preparation after complete clinical and recipient checks?

already_counted.description: Capture actual referral meaning within s4.

incremental.description: Maintain actual medical-source and referral field links.

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked final actual assessment/referral record and exact patient encounter; edits require recheck
s5 checked final actual referral and exact authorised recipient/disclosure scope; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 navigation + 14*0.20 repeated fields = 8.8; minus 1 upkeep = 7.8. Half eligible gives 4.4 minus 1 = 3.4. Assessment, team communication, actual capture, full review and actions retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Dispense herbal formulas and explain their use and risks.

steps.what: Retrieve actual patient medicine/allergy history and verified herbal formula product information
inputs: actual patient medicines, allergies and clinical context
actual product composition, instructions and current safety references
outputs: checked actual patient/formula information and unresolved uncertainties

steps.what: Check actual formula, dose, frequency, duration, side effects and possible drug interactions
inputs: checked actual patient/formula information and unresolved uncertainties
actual patient needs and permitted professional scope
outputs: actual final formula/quantity and patient-specific use instructions or decision not to dispense

steps.what: Dispense the actual checked herbal formula and quantity to the correct patient
inputs: actual final formula/quantity and patient-specific use instructions or decision not to dispense
actual product and patient identity
outputs: actual dispensed formula and quantity when appropriate

steps.what: Inform patients of actual dosage, frequency, duration, side effects and drug interaction concerns
inputs: actual final formula/quantity and patient-specific use instructions or decision not to dispense
actual patient questions and understanding
outputs: actual patient explanation and understanding check

steps.what: Record and check actual formula dispensed, instructions provided and unresolved clinical concerns
inputs: actual dispensed formula and quantity when appropriate
actual patient explanation and understanding check
actual final formula/quantity and patient-specific use instructions or decision not to dispense

steps.what: Commit the checked actual dispensing and counselling record
inputs: checked final actual dispensing/counselling record
outputs: committed actual herbal formula encounter record

tasks.design: Configure native patient/product reference links in clinical record/formulary software {OTHER} and {DOCS}. Retain actual suitability and safety assessment, product/dose checking, physical dispensing, patient explanation and full record capture/check before a separate commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Dispensing preparation can repeat patient/product reference navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links can reduce retrieval without generating clinical instructions.
tasks.still_hard: Product composition, uncertain interactions and patient-specific safety need qualified assessment.
tasks.human_edge: The practitioner recognises unresolved safety information requiring withholding dispensing or specialist advice.
tasks.altitude: Less reference navigation; dispensing and patient counselling remain human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native patient/product reference links can shorten retrieval; they do not establish herbal efficacy, complete interaction coverage or appropriate dosing.

assumptions: Actual patient/clinical owners supply medicine/allergy history and actual product owners provide composition/instructions; practitioner checks currentness in s1. Missing composition or unresolved safety concerns require actual professional review, not invented interaction advice.

All suitability decisions, final product/quantity/instruction checking, physical dispensing and patient counselling remain retained. No autonomous dose selection, interaction clearance or treatment efficacy is assumed.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native reference links first; existing integrated access earns zero saving. S2 is actual final dispensing decision, with no added approval time; no-dispense cases remove physical branch and reweight.

Actual dispensing must be within professional authority. Outcomes are recorded only after actual dispensing/counselling. Record capture/check and one-percent commit remain retained; any separate prescription/order/send must be its own exact-final-content gated action if actually required.
research_questions: Can native links reduce retrieval while preserving complete suitability and safety assessment?

incremental.description: Maintain actual verified patient/product reference links.

approvals.approved_version: s2 actual final formula, quantity, patient-specific instructions and correct patient with actual dispensing authority; changes require reassessment
s5 checked final actual dispensing/counselling record and exact patient encounter; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 reference navigation = 6; minus 0.5 upkeep = 5.5. Half eligible gives 3 minus 0.5 = 2.5. Suitability, dispensing, counselling, actual record/check and commit retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Acupuncturists retain clinical and patient communication work while actual reference navigation may shrink.
role.ambitious_version: Measure actual navigation and stable fields without inferring clinical authority, interaction safety or treatment outcomes.
